description: The union of a set of von Neumann ordinals is their least upper bound under inclusion, including the empty family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ordinal_union_lub.{u} (S : ZFSet.{u}) (hS : ∀ a ∈ S, a.IsOrdinal) :
  (∀ a ∈ S, a ⊆ S.sUnion) ∧ ∀ (b : ZFSet.{u}), b.IsOrdinal → (∀ a ∈ S, a ⊆ b) → S.sUnion ⊆ b
